newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to discuss today ports selloff - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to discuss today ports selloff - paper.

text.p: The National Privatisation Council (CND) meets today in Brasilia to prepare the privatisation of Brazilian ports, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said on Tuesday.
The CND members will examine the proposal to transfer to private investors, under leasing agreements, four ports by the end of the year: Itajai, Laguna, Cabedelo and Porto Velho, the newspaper said.
A total of 27 ports will be privatised, it added.
The CND is also expected to discuss the sale of 1.39 billion reais in shares of privatised firms which remained with the government and minority stakes in 43 companies, Gazeta said.

The council is also expected to set the dates for the privatisation auctions of two railway sections and the date for publication of the tender documents for mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).
